description: Na₆MgV₂(S₃O)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are six inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.22 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.37 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to four S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.73-3.13 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.33 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.86-3.13 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.36 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.85-3.18 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.30 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to five S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.77-3.35 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.27 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four S and one O atom. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.87-3.06 Å. The Na-O bond length is 2.39 Å. Mg is bonded to four S atoms to form distorted MgS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four VS₃O tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mg-S bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.49 Å. There are two inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to three S and one O atom to form distorted VS₃O tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgS₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-S bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.38 Å. The V-O bond length is 1.71 Å. In the second V site, V is bonded to three S and one O atom to form distorted VS₃O tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgS₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (2.23 Å) and two longer (2.35 Å) V-S bond lengths. The V-O bond length is 1.72 Å. There are six inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one V atom. In the fourth S site, S is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one V atom. In the fifth S site, S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one V atom. In the sixth S site, S is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one V atom. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to three Na and one V atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to three Na and one V atom.
